name: Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years' aggregate legal residence in Jamaica.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of aggregate legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: 12 months' continuous residence immediately preceding the application.
requirements.fix_path: Remain resident in Jamaica for the 12 months immediately before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: Good character, evidenced by a clean police record.

evidence_required.document: Newspaper publication of the application, twice, one week apart
JMD 50,000 processing fee + JMD 1,000 Stamp Office endorsement

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 12 months continuous residence immediately preceding application, within a 5-year aggregate residence requirement

sources.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (PICA), Jamaica -- Naturalisation: age 18+, 5 years' aggregate residence with 12 months immediately preceding, good character, Form N1, 4 Jamaican-born references, publication in a newspaper twice one week apart, fees JMD 50,000 (processing) + JMD 1,000 (Stamp Office endorsement), ~24 months processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- directly fetched by me from pica.gov.jm, tier-1. FEE CONFLICT DISCLOSED: JIS (Jamaica Information Service) public-facing material elsewhere cites a JMD 20,000 naturalisation fee; PICA's own current page states JMD 50,000 + 1,000. This dataset uses PICA's figure as the authoritative one since PICA is the operational agency processing the applications, but the discrepancy suggests JIS content may be outdated -- flagged for anyone cross-checking against JIS sources. Processing time ~24 months is notably long relative to other naturalisation routes in this dataset. dual_citizenship_allowed is TRUE -- Jamaica permits dual/multiple citizenship without restriction, unlike several other countries built in this dataset (Bahrain, Ethiopia).
